repos_data.description: This project reproduces the book Dive Into Deep Learning (https://d2l.ai/), adapting the code from MXNet into PyTorch.

MCP server for Brightspace (D2L). Check grades, due dates, assignments, announcements, rosters, syllabus & course content via Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client. Works with any school. npm: npx brightspace-mcp-server@latest

Brightspace D2L MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Copilot. Knows what you already handed in, so it only tells you what is actually left. Due dates, grades and course files at any school with normal SSO sign-in.
